date_note: TechCrunch (published 2026-11-25) says the outage has lasted since Monday morning; Monday was 23 November.
title: Allstate website and app outage since Monday blocks customers from accounts, claims and payments, TechCrunch reports
geo_basis: country: TechCrunch says customers nationwide are affected; no city stated
summary: TechCrunch reports an Allstate outage since Monday morning stops customers reaching accounts, claims and bill payments on its website and app. Newsweek, on the third day, says the site shows a "site update" message. Breitbart reports Allstate said on Wednesday that customers affected by the "service interruptions" will not lose coverage or be charged late fees. No cause or restoration time is reported.
plain: TechCrunch reports Allstate customers across the US have been unable to use its website and app since Monday. Breitbart reports Allstate said affected customers will not lose coverage or be charged late fees; no cause has been given.
exec: TechCrunch reports a multi-day Allstate outage blocking claims, policy access and payments; Allstate says affected customers keep coverage and pay no late fees (per Breitbart); no cause stated.

validation.note: Two independent publishers (TechCrunch, Newsweek) each report the multi-day outage; Allstate's own page not read.

review.note: Checked outage dates, scope, no cause, site update notice and restore statement against TechCrunch and Newsweek
